summary: Verified P0 LEAD dashboard cross-user data-leak fix. Added focused regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_lead_dashboard_scope.py covering contract, foreign-owned isolation (no leak into any LEAD counter), own-owned positive contribution, and OWNER regression (still counts all). Re-ran existing P0 #1 ECP detail IDOR suite and P0 #2 LEAD ECP list suite alongside — all green.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard() (server.py:1243) is ~160 lines with many if/elif role branches — consider extracting per-role builders for maintainability.
LEAD scope filter (_own = (user['id'], None)) is duplicated in leads GET, ecps GET, and now dashboard. Extract a helper `_lead_scope_filter(user)` to avoid drift.

dashboard() loads up to 5000 leads + 5000 ecps + 5000 payments + 5000 site_visits + 5000 lead_followups per request and filters in Python. As data grows, switch to Mongo aggregation with $match for role scope.
seed_data_creation: Fixture inserts (and tears down) synthetic docs: 6 foreign-owned leads (PENDING+action_required, FOLLOW_UP+followup today, SITE_VISIT, ESCALATED, QUALIFIED, LOST), 1 foreign-owned lead_followups, 1 foreign-owned lead_site_visits, 1 foreign-owned PENDING_DOCUMENTS ECP, 1 own PENDING_DOCUMENTS ECP, 1 own QUALIFIED lead. All prefixed TEST_ and deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New file /app/backend/tests/test_lead_dashboard_scope.py verifies LEAD dashboard scoping. NOTE: When running the full backend suite with xdist parallel workers, this suite can transiently race with test_ecp_detail_scope::test_registration_scope because the synthetic PENDING_DOCUMENTS ECPs live briefly in the shared DB. Running with -n0 (or running the file alone) is stable — all 26 tests + 1 pre-existing skip pass. The failure is not a security regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: dashboard() loaded db.leads/db.ecps/db.lead_site_visits unrestricted and computed LEAD counters (action_required, followups_today, waiting_site_visit, escalated, qualified, lost, pending_documents) over the full unscoped datasets, so foreign-owner leads/ECPs inflated a LEAD user's dashboard. Fix (server.py:1248-1251, 1280-1282): after loading, when role=='LEAD', filter leads and ecps to lead_owner_id in (user.id, None) BEFORE enrich; filter site_visits to those whose lead_id is in the scoped leads. Verified: (a) after inserting 6 foreign-owned leads across PENDING/SITE_VISIT/ESCALATED/QUALIFIED/LOST/FOLLOW_UP + foreign PENDING_DOCUMENTS ECP + foreign site_visit, LEAD dashboard counters change ONLY by the expected own-record deltas (qualified +1, pending_documents +1) — 0 delta from foreign inserts on all 7 counters; (b) OWNER dashboard counters correctly include the foreign inserts; (c) contract keys unchanged; (d) existing P0 #1 and #2 suites remain green.
